query:
SELECT 
  s.companyName,
  s.id as sponsorId,
  COUNT(m.id) as total_meetings,
  MAX(m.attendeeNumber) as max_attendees
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.sponsorId = s.id AND m.isVisible = 1
WHERE s.companyName NOT IN ('Little Moment','Elevate Assess','AI Limited','NexaTalent Solutions Ltd','Visibility Test Company','Test Sponsor mtgtest-1773930263708')
GROUP BY s.id, s.companyName
HAVING COUNT(m.id) < 24
ORDER BY total_meetings ASC;
